title: Lecture notes on ridge regression
text: Ridge regression augments the regression loss with a penalty on squared coefficients. This addresses estimation identifiability problems in high-dimensional regression. The paper reviews estimator moments, mean squared error, constrained-estimation and Bayesian interpretations. It also discusses generalized penalties and logistic regression. The abstract does not provide a diabetes dataset result or an optimal alpha for this experiment; parameter choices remain hypotheses to evaluate on validation data.
